title: Computing Equilibria in Simulation-Based Insurance Markets with Discontinuous Demand
summary: We study equilibrium computation in simulation-based games motivated by competition in natural-hazard insurance markets. The motivating application considers a multi-region market in which each insurer selects regional pricing and reinsurance decisions to maximize expected financial performance subject to multi-period insolvency constraints. Competitors' decisions affect both profitability and insolvency feasibility through the insured portfolio.
